name: sqlserver-review-mcp
description: Read-only SQL Server diagnostics for application performance/architecture reviews: schema, indexes, execution plans, Query Store, waits.

sqlserver_host.title: SQL Server Host
sqlserver_host.description: Hostname or IP of the SQL Server instance, e.g. sql-review.internal.pttdigital.com

sqlserver_user.title: SQL Login (read-only review account)
sqlserver_user.description: Use the dedicated mcp_code_review account created via sql/create-review-user.sql — never a write-capable account. Leave blank if using Windows/Entra ID auth below.

sqlserver_password.title: SQL Password
sqlserver_password.description: Password for the read-only review account. Leave blank if using Windows/Entra ID auth.

sqlserver_use_windows_auth.title: Use Windows Authentication
sqlserver_use_windows_auth.description: 'true' to use integrated/Windows auth instead of the SQL login above

sqlserver_use_azure_ad.title: Use Azure AD (Entra ID) Authentication
sqlserver_use_azure_ad.description: 'true' for Azure SQL Database with Entra ID default-credential auth

sqlserver_trust_server_certificate.title: Trust Server Certificate
sqlserver_trust_server_certificate.description: 'true' only for on-prem servers with a self-signed cert you trust; keep 'false' otherwise

sqlserver_query_timeout_ms.title: Query Timeout (ms)
sqlserver_query_timeout_ms.description: Per-query timeout enforced on every tool call

sqlserver_max_rows.title: Maximum Rows Per Response
sqlserver_max_rows.description: Hard cap on rows returned by any tool, regardless of what the caller requests

mcp_log_level.title: Log Level
mcp_log_level.description: debug | info | warn | error (logs go to stderr, never stdout)

mcp_audit_log.title: Enable Audit Log
mcp_audit_log.description: 'true' to emit one structured audit line per tool call

mcp_redact_columns.title: Redacted Column Patterns
mcp_redact_columns.description: Comma-separated column-name substrings whose values are replaced with ***REDACTED*** in query results

sqlserver_enable_ad_hoc_sql.title: Enable Ad-Hoc SQL Tools (execute_select / get_estimated_plan)
sqlserver_enable_ad_hoc_sql.description: 'true' to expose sqlserver.execute_select and sqlserver.get_estimated_plan — the only two tools that run caller-supplied SQL text. Keep 'false' until the login above is the locked-down mcp_code_review account, not a broad test/admin login. Every other tool only runs fixed queries and is unaffected either way.
